system_metadata.title: CYBERNETIC JOURNAL
system_metadata.subtitle: An Apparatus of Autopoietic Stabilization and Temporal Bifurcation
system_metadata.tagline: CYCLE 1 - 3 // EPOCH SPAN: 93 DAYS // A5 STAMP

guide_text.manifesto_body: This journal is a physical-conceptual instrument of material-discursive boundary making. It is designed to restructure cognitive pathways, regulate intensive energy, and balance stability (homeostasis) with adaptive mutation (homeorhesis). It operates on two distinct temporal scales: Chronos (striated, clock-measured administrative time) and Aion (smooth, intensive evental time of creative play).
guide_text.protocols_morning:
▲ ATTRACTORS: Intensive focus pulls towards primary goals.
■ STABILIZERS: Homeostatic routines (maintenance habits, diet, rest).
⤏ FLIGHT LINES: Rhizomatic escapes, creative detours, and deviations.
▼ RESISTORS: Friction points, cognitive drag, and thermodynamic limits.
guide_text.protocols_evening:
At the end of the day, audit your systemic coordinates:
1. STATE SPACE: Plot a single coordinate indicating Vitality/Joy and Flow/Discipline.
2. ENTANGLEMENT AUDIT: Record where agency was captured by bad assemblages (interfaces, distractions).
3. DIFFRACTION PATTERN: Register how actions rippled out and caused constructive or destructive wave interference.
4. FEEDFORWARD SEED: Inscribe a single seed to initialize tomorrow's state.

dimensions.name: FLIGHT VELOCITY
dimensions.desc: Rate of creative escape, detour, and unexpected rhizomatic associations.

dimensions.name: THERMODYNAMIC RESISTANCE
dimensions.desc: Cognitive drag, somatic exhaustion, and system-level friction.

dimensions.name: VITALITY / JOY
dimensions.desc: Spinozian affect score. Measure of intensive power of action.

dimensions.name: DIFFRACTION RATIO
dimensions.desc: Coherence of actions. High values indicate constructive wave ripples.

dimensions.name: CHRONOS METRIC
dimensions.desc: Completion rate of scheduled linear tasks.

dimensions.name: AION DRIFT
dimensions.desc: Depth and duration of un-dated evental time and research play.
